choices.reason: The earlier rules do not separate the two AI-versus-control contrasts, and neither supplies participant-level standardization statistics. Of the two structured arms, textual concretization is closer to general-chatbot use because it returns GPT-generated text directly for iterative refinement, while visual concretization routes GPT-generated prompts through DALL-E.
